spark.doc: A small lime-gold spark burst (tells, clicks). Billboard.

flash.doc: A white-green glow flash (bright moments). Billboard.

leaf_splash.doc: Leaf + mote splash on the withered field (P1 land, P4 crash, Q3 shell 1): olive-green leaves flung up, airborne spray. At the floor point.

water_splash.doc: Water + leaf splash on the lush sheet (Q1, Q3s, CS t92, D t82). At the floor point.

burrow_pool.doc: The dark olive leaf pool the boss sinks into (E t0, P1 t4, P3 t5): spreads to radius {r} (35 = 7 b across) in 10 t and lasts 40 t. At the floor point.

leaf_flakes.doc: Black leaf flakes rising (E, P1 sink). At the floor point.

bulb_flash.doc: The flash at the Heart bulb (E t60). At the bulb.

gold_embers.doc: Golden leaf embers drifting around the raised hand (E t63-80, every 4 t). At the bulb.

shadow_glide.doc: Underground travel (P1 t23-44, P3 t23-39, every 2 t): a dark leaf ripple and dust over the hidden body. Particles only. At the hidden anchor (floor).

gold_burst.doc: The burst (P1 t44, P3 slams): a white-gold flash and radial crystal blades, airborne (the ground decal is the hazard's). At the floor point.

leaf_debris.doc: Black leaf debris and a pale ghost-leaf spray (P1 burst). At the floor point.

slash_band.doc: The lunge sweep (P1 t64): a white-gold streak band 1-2.5 b high along the lane of length {len}. At the lane start, rotated = the aim.

spine_afterimage.doc: Pale rib afterimages along the sweep path of length {len}, 10 t (P1 sweep). At the lane start, rotated = the aim.

root_chunks.doc: Brown root chunks with gold glints sinking (R t4, T1 t20 / t30). At the floor point.

emerge_motes.doc: White-green motes of the 4 t scale-in (R t18). At the body.

swirl_wisps.doc: Pale-green spirals and whirling leaves around the body (P2 t5-27, every 4 t). At the body.

plunge_flash.doc: The white-gold flash where the hands plunge (P2 t30). At the floor point.

splinter_splash.doc: The pale-green splinter splash around the hands (P2 t30, r 3-4). At the floor point.

slam_arc.doc: A stalk slam (P2 slams): the arc trail over the strip, the impact flash and green splinters. At the stalk root, rotated along the strip.

gold_glow.doc: A soft gold ground glow of radius {r}, no rim (P3 t39-44: it must not read as a telegraph). At the floor point.

crown_debris.doc: The crown and hood emergence debris (P3 t44): dark leaves and grey dust thrown up. At the body.

spiral_wisps.doc: Wind-up spirals around the coiled column (P3 t94-130, every 4 t). At the body.

blade_burst.doc: Gold blade rays to radius {r}, airborne (P3 slams, r 72). At the floor point.

wheel_carpet.doc: The thorn-wheel carpet (P3 slams): 18 pale-green thorn wheels ride the carpet front from radius {r0} to {r1} in {dur} ticks (tenths / ticks, like the hazard). Call it on the tick BEFORE the slam (the fg wave_band rule): the wheels then move from the slam tick with the tele/wave front. At the floor centre.

homing_trail.doc: The homing wheel's gold-orange spark trail (P3, every 2 t; particles only). At the wheel; run it as the wheel (execute as <wheel> at @s) and it also turns the prop 90 degrees (the camera-facing spin).

wheel_pop.doc: A thorn wheel pops (P3, end of life or hit): a gold-orange flash and sparks (r 1.5). At the prop.

spin_trails.doc: Spin trails white-gold -> pale green around the body (P4 t47-71, every 3 t). At the body.

spin_flash.doc: The mid-spin flash (P4 t57). At the body.

tail_tip_flash.doc: The white tail-tip flash: the "dash now" cue (P5 t23, Q4 t11). At the tail tip anchor.

arc_trail.doc: The white-gold arc trail over a tail swing (P5): 7 crescents on the circle of radius 0.8 {r} about the tail root from -{a} to +{a} degrees, revealed in the sweep direction {dir} (+1 clockwise from above). At the tail root, rotated = the arc's mid-bearing.

crescent_trail.doc: The green crescent trails of a phase-3 tail swing (Q4; #A4D6AC / #BFE682 / #EBF898): 7 crescents on the circle of radius 0.8 {r} from -{a} to +{a} degrees, revealed in the sweep direction {dir}. At the tail root, rotated = the arc's mid-bearing.

arm_sweep.doc: The arm-sweep arc and ground furrow (P6 hit 1): 5 crescents on the circle of radius 0.75 {r} over +-{a} degrees, left to right. At the body, rotated = the aim.

slam_burst.doc: The double-slam radial burst (P6 hit 2): a white-gold floor flash, a shock ring, crystal blades and dark debris. At the floor point.

spin_ring.doc: The ring of gold sparks of the low spin (P6 hit 3), radius {r}. At the body.

leap_slam.doc: The leap slam (P6 hit 4): the biggest flash, black and gold debris. At the floor point.

spawn_marker.doc: An organism spawn marker: a pale wireframe dome for 20 t (T1 t116, every spawn). At the spawn point.

org_burst.doc: A pale-green organism burst (basic kill, failure, CS wilt). At the organism.

heart_gain.doc: The Heart's gain sparkle (heart/add). At the bulb.

heart_hit.doc: The Heart's loss: red-gold motes (heart/sub). At the bulb.

crown_flare.doc: The basic organism's crown flare (O2 t3-12). At the crown.

comet_trail.doc: The bolt's green comet trail, bowing <= 0.5 b (O2, every 2 t; particles only). At the bolt prop.

shield_pop.doc: The yellow 3-leaf crown flash of a shield (O3 shields up, a pool breaking). At the basic.

guard_death.doc: The 수호 death: red embers and a black twisted wisp. At the 수호.

wall_motes.doc: A wall blade dissolves into motes (O4). At the blade.

blink_flash.doc: The 둥지 blink flash (O4 blink out 0 / in 3). At the 둥지.

tether.doc: One wavy 양육 tether beam of length {len} toward the basic (O5, refresh every 2 t; particles only, dust #D4E784, the wave flips phase every 2 t). At the 양육 orb, rotated facing the basic (pitch counts).

nurt_burst.doc: The 양육 self-destruct: green-yellow sparks. At the 양육.

bite_flash.doc: A white-yellow bite flash (O6b). At the bite point.

o1_hit.doc: The basic organism's melee strike (O1 t10; AP-I2, requests/ap-rev.md RREV-6): a small pale-green flash and leaf bits at the cone. At the strike point (1.6 b ahead of the basic, 0.6 b up).

pred_burst.doc: The 포식성 burst r 3.6 (O6a t42). At the 포식성.

fuse_pulse.doc: One 파괴 fuse glow pulse (O7; every 9 t, every 4 t in the last 20 t). At the 파괴 face.

blast_dome.doc: The 파괴 blast: a green translucent dome r 3 for 12 t. At the 파괴.

cradle_dust.doc: Root-chunk dust of the cradle rise (T1 t45-65). At the cradle.

heart_beam.doc: The green-gold light beam as the egg lands, 10 t (T1 t100). At the cradle.

gold_motes.doc: Drifting gold motes over the phase-2 field (every 20 t). At the floor centre.

shock_ring.doc: The 「소생 실패」 Dendro shock ring r 0 -> 26. At the floor centre.

wilt_ring.doc: The green pulse ring r 0 -> 26 over 20 t as every organism wilts (CS t0). At the floor centre.

gold_drip.doc: Gold dripping from the lifted egg (CS t0-24, every 3 t). At the egg.

ember_arc.doc: The 「불씨」 ember: a spark arcs {h} high over the {len} from a bank twig into the egg (CS t64-76; 12 sparks shown one after another). At the twig, rotated facing the egg (pitch counts).

green_lightning.doc: Green lightning ribbons around the egg (CS t76-84). At the egg.

revival_burst.doc: The leaf splash of the warden bursting out of the water (CS t92). At the floor centre.

leaf_mound.doc: The leaf mound and spray where the boss sinks (Q1 t8, Q3s t8). At the floor point.

leaf_pad.doc: One translucent 2-3 b leaf pad of the underground trail, life 30 t (Q1 t16-42, Q3s t20-36, every 4 t). At the hidden anchor (floor), rotated as the trail.

rosette.doc: The rosette: 10 glowing leaves rising around the burst point, airborne (Q1 t32; the ground ring is tele/disc r 4.2). At the burst point.

surface_burst.doc: The white-lime surfacing flash and leaf spray (Q1 t44). At the burst point.

hoop_trail.doc: The hoop arc trail as the body vaults (Q1 t44-49). At the body.

belly_splash.doc: The belly-flop splash (Q1 t61). At the floor point.

sweep_ring.doc: The leaf-blade ring of the 360-degree tail whip, radius {r} (Q1 t69; core #E0F996, rim #A2CA6C). At the body.

light_sprouts.doc: Light sprouts at the rise (Q1 t71). At the body.

crouch_splash.doc: The splash as the boss crouches to charge (Q2 t0). At the body.

whirl_leaves.doc: Whirling leaves around the body (Q2 t18-36, every 3 t; the three positions rotate each call). At the body.

field_ring.doc: The visible front of the 종말의 여파 field release: a flat translucent yellow-green wave from radius {r0} to {r1} in {dur} ticks (Q2 t40). At the floor centre.

floor_glitter.doc: Glitter on the tinted 종말의 여파 floor (Q2 t80-155, every 10 t). At the floor centre.

light_pillar.doc: A 10 t light-pillar tell where a dome will form (Q2 t44 / 48 / 52). At the dome centre.

dome_rise.doc: The base-rim sparkle as a dome forms (Q2 t54 / 58 / 62; dome r 4.5). At the dome centre.

beam_rain.doc: Falling light columns over the disc (Q2 t134-156, every 4 t; the three positions rotate each call). At the floor centre.

flood.doc: The 종말의 여파 flood: yellow tiles over the walk disc for {life} ticks, skipping every cell within 7.5 b of a live rlk_mb_ap_dome marker (the flood pool, <= 48 cards). At the floor centre.

flood_part.doc: The 종말의 여파 flood sliced over three ticks (AP-I2, requests/ap-p3.md RP3-3: the whole flood in one tick passed the 3000-commands budget): part {part} = 0 / 1 / 2 draws every third cell of p/flood (part 0 also the flash), {life} ticks. Call parts 0, 1, 2 on three consecutive ticks with life 24, 23, 22. At the floor centre.

dome_pop.doc: A dome pops: a flash and lime shards (Q2 t189). At the dome centre.

green_burst.doc: A green burst at the boss (Q2 t190). At the body.

launch_flash.doc: The launch flash at the crown / muzzle (Q3 t35, Q3s t46). At the anchor.

beam_column.doc: A vertical light beam column {w} wide (#FDFBBD; Q3 t45, Q3s t48, Q5 t14). At the floor point.

spores.doc: Spore puffs on the water after a shell (Q3 t45). At the floor point.

shell_streak.doc: A yellow streak falling from {h} above onto the point in 6 t (Q3 t87 / 90; call it 6 t before the impact). At the floor point.

shell_burst.doc: A shell burst r 3 (Q3 t93 / 96, Q3s t48). At the floor point.

leaf_ring.doc: Leaf cards circling the surfacing decal (Q3s t26-36): 8 leaves on r 3.6 shown around the ring one after another. At the floor point.

surface_splash.doc: The surfacing splash (Q3s t36). At the floor point.

light_band.doc: The horizontal light band of the flat surfacing shot over {len} (Q3s t46). At the muzzle anchor, rotated = the shot.

glitter_shower.doc: A glitter shower over the body (Q4 t53). At the body.

charge_streaks.doc: Charge streaks converging on the body (Q5 t10-19). At the body.

star_flare.doc: A 4-point star flare at the glint (Q5 t37 / t43). At the glint point.

helix_trail.doc: The double-helix ribbon behind a seed orb (Q5 t42-55, every tick; particles only): two sine strands, dust #E7F99F -> #8BCAAA, the phase turning 45 degrees a tick. At the orb, rotated as its flight.

orb_impact.doc: A seed-orb landing: a star burst and two upthrust crystal / leaf spikes (Q5 t49 / t55). At the floor point.

leaf_skim.doc: Two skimming pale-yellow leaf blades along the lane of length {len} (Q5 t64). At the lane start, rotated = the aim.

leaf_dissolve.doc: A white leaflet burst as the body dissolves (D t100-118, every 6 t). At the body.

haze_withered.doc: The withered olive haze drift (phase 1, T1, phase 2; every 10 t; particles only). At the floor centre.

haze_lush.doc: The lush spore and glint haze (from CS t64; every 10 t; particles only). At the floor centre.

props.thorn_wheel_homing: P3 homing wheel (pj, #pjNoDodge 1): gold-orange thorn wheel Ø 2 with a red 4-point flare, camera-facing; p/homing_trail run as it spins it.
props.thorn_wheel: P3 carpet wheel as a prop (fallback): pale-green thorn wheel Ø 1.6, camera-facing.
props.seed_bolt: O2 ranged bolt: lime seed ball Ø 0.6 with a glow, camera-facing.
props.seed_orb: Q5 seed orb Ø 0.7: glowing yellow-green with a spiral glyph, camera-facing (the module moves / bobs it).
props.charge_ball: Q3 light ball over the crown: #FDFBBD core, white-green halo, camera-facing, Ø 1.6.
props.water_sheet: One water-sheet tile of the lush lake (theme props('lush'), 16 tiles at scale 14, y 201.005): flat, about 40 % alpha. The record sets the scale.
props.lily_pad: Lily pad (lush pond dressing beyond r 22), flat; the record sets the scale.
props.bell_flower: Yellow bell flowers (lush pond dressing beyond r 22), crossed quads; the record sets the scale.
props.bulb_flower: Glowing bulb flower (lush pond dressing beyond r 22), crossed quads; the record sets the scale.
props.bank_crystal: Gold crystal spikes on the bank r 26-29 (both looks), brightness 15; the record sets the scale.
props.gate_crystal: Gold-green gate crystal of the chapter-3 entrance (≈ 1.5 b at scale 1), brightness 15, static.

p3_glow.use: P3 t39: the gold ground glow.

p5_swing.use: P5 t28 / t52: a tail swing.

o6_bite_first.use: O6b the first bite of a chain.

cs_emerge.use: CS t92: the warden bursts out of the water.

q1_slam.use: Q1 t61 / t69: the slam and the whip.

d_splash.use: D t82: the topple onto the water.
